command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){foreach(`$c in @('display current-configuration','show running-config','ifconfig')){`$e=[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n.node_id+'/command?cmd='+`$e; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; if(`$o -match '160\.0\.0\.1'){Write-Output ('===== '+`$n.name+' '+`$c+' ====='); Write-Output `$o}}}"
